identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a high-density, functional, and aesthetically sharp work order management system that feels like a professional tool, not a generic admin panel.
principles: Density is Clarity: Use tight spacing to show more data without clutter.
Function over Form: Every pixel must serve a purpose. No decorative gradients.
Industrial Aesthetics: Use technical fonts, sharp borders, and high-contrast colors.
Speed is a Feature: Interactions must be instant. Hover states should be snappy.

headings.usage: Page titles, Section headers, Modal titles

body.usage: General text, Form labels, Button text

mono.usage: OT Numbers, Dates, IDs, Status codes

primary.description: IBM Technical Blue - Use for primary actions, active states, and key highlights.

secondary.description: Industrial Grey - Use for secondary buttons, backgrounds, and borders.

accent.description: Safety Orange - Use sparingly for 'Urgent' tags, alerts, or critical notifications.

usage_rules: Use the 'Technical Blue' only for the main call-to-action.
Use 'Safety Orange' ONLY for alerts or high-priority status.
Borders should be subtle (slate-200) but sharp (1px).

containers.card: bg-white border border-border shadow-sm rounded-none md:rounded-sm
containers.sidebar: bg-slate-50 border-r border-border h-full flex flex-col

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-9 px-4 py-2 rounded-sm font-medium text-sm transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-9 px-4 py-2 rounded-sm font-medium text-sm transition-colors
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 py-2 rounded-sm font-medium text-sm transition-colors

inputs.default: flex h-9 w-full rounded-sm border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50
inputs.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 block

table.header: h-10 px-4 text-left align-middle font-medium text-muted-foreground bg-slate-50/50 border-b border-border

status_badge.base: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2

general: Use 'Chivo' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body text.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for any ID, Date, or Code-like data.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states.
Use the defined color palette. Do not introduce new colors unless necessary for status indication.
Prioritize density in the dashboard table. It should look like a professional tool.

layout_specifics.dashboard: Create a sidebar layout. The main content should be a large, filterable table of Work Orders.
layout_specifics.create_ot_form: Use a slide-over (Sheet) or a clean Modal for creating OTs. Do not navigate away from the dashboard.
layout_specifics.details_view: When clicking a row, open a detailed view (Sheet or Modal) to keep context.

component_usage.tables: Use the custom table styles defined in 'components.table'. Add a 'zebra-stripe' effect if readability is low.
component_usage.forms: Use 'react-hook-form' with 'zod' validation. Labels should be uppercase and small.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) sparingly, mostly for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
